results.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
results.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week, subject to manager approval and role suitability.

results.question: What is required for a fully remote arrangement?
results.expected_answer: Fully remote arrangements require director-level sign-off and are reviewed every six months.

results.question: During what hours must remote employees be reachable?
results.expected_answer: Remote employees must be reachable during core hours, 10:00-16:00 local time.

results.question: Who provides equipment for remote work, and what happens to it at offboarding?
results.expected_answer: The company provides remote work equipment, which must be returned upon request or at offboarding, per the Equipment and Asset Policy.

results.question: What are the standard working hours?
results.expected_answer: Standard working hours are 40 hours per week, with core collaboration hours of 10:00-16:00 local time.

results.question: Does working remotely change an employee's tax residency obligations?
results.expected_answer: No, remote work does not change an employee's tax residency obligations, which remain the employee's responsibility.

results.question: What devices must employees use to access production systems and customer data?
results.expected_answer: Employees must use company-issued devices for accessing production systems and customer data.

results.question: Is two-factor authentication mandatory?
results.expected_answer: Yes, two-factor authentication is mandatory for all internal and customer-facing systems.

results.question: How quickly must a suspected security incident be reported?
results.expected_answer: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the IT Security team within 24 hours of discovery.

results.question: What happens if an employee violates the security policy?
results.expected_answer: Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination, per the Code of Conduct.

results.question: Can employees use company devices for personal use?
results.expected_answer: Incidental personal use of company devices and accounts is permitted within reasonable limits.

results.question: Can employees install unauthorized software on company devices?
results.expected_answer: No, installation of unauthorized software is prohibited without IT approval.

results.question: How many days of annual leave do employees receive after one year of service?
results.expected_answer: Employees who have completed one year of service receive 15 days of annual leave per calendar year.

results.question: How does annual leave work for employees with less than one year of service?
results.expected_answer: Employees with less than one year of service accrue annual leave on a monthly basis.

results.question: How far in advance should annual leave normally be requested?
results.expected_answer: Annual leave should normally be requested at least three business days before the intended date.

results.question: How many paid sick days do employees receive per year?
results.expected_answer: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year, available from the first day of employment.

results.question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
results.expected_answer: A medical certificate submitted to HR is required when sick leave is taken for more than three consecutive days.

results.question: How much paid parental leave does the company provide beyond statutory requirements?
results.expected_answer: The company provides two weeks of fully paid parental leave in addition to statutory entitlements.

results.question: What happens to unused annual leave at the end of the year?
results.expected_answer: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried into the next calendar year, and any remaining balance expires on January 31.

results.question: Within how many days must business expenses be submitted?
results.expected_answer: Business expenses must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date via the finance portal.

results.question: What approval is required for an expense of $100 or more?
results.expected_answer: Expenses of $100 or more require both manager and finance approval.

results.question: When are approved expense reimbursements processed?
results.expected_answer: Reimbursements are processed within one payroll cycle following approval.

results.question: How should business travel be booked?
results.expected_answer: Business travel must be booked through the approved corporate travel portal wherever available.

results.question: What is the daily per diem for meals during business travel?
results.expected_answer: A daily per diem of $60 applies for meals not covered by a hosted event.

results.question: What happens if a personal expense is submitted in error?
results.expected_answer: Personal expenses submitted in error will be deducted from the next payroll cycle.

results.question: When does health insurance coverage take effect for new employees?
results.expected_answer: Health insurance coverage is effective from the first day of the month following the employee's start date.

results.question: When can dependents be added to the health insurance plan?
results.expected_answer: Dependents may be added during the annual open enrollment period or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.

results.question: When are employees eligible to enroll in the retirement plan?
results.expected_answer: Employees are eligible to enroll in the company retirement plan after 90 days of service.

results.question: What is the company's retirement contribution match?
results.expected_answer: The company matches employee contributions up to 4% of base salary.
